title.narrative: Strengthening ESD in schools and communities in World Heritage Sites and UNESCO Biosphere Reserves in Cuba and the Dominican Republic

description.narrative:
The main objectives of the project focus on:
1. Contribute to the implementation of the actions of the national ESD strategies and the UNESCO principles on Greening Education, in the World Heritage Sites and biosphere reserves of Cuba and the Dominican Republic.
2. Train teachers and students from schools belonging to the World Heritage Sites and biosphere reserves of Cuba and the Dominican Republic in UNESCO programs related to Education for Sustainable Development (ESD, Sandwatch, Ocean Literacy and Trash Hack).
3. Promote climate action, nature-based solutions and solid waste reduction on the coasts of the World Heritage Sites and biosphere reserves of Cuba and the Dominican Republic through beach cleaning activities with teachers, students and the community.
4. Strengthen school curricula and study plans in Cuba and the Dominican Republic through actions and projects resulting from the systematization of good practices and the added value of World Heritage Sites and Biosphere Reserves in the implementation of Education for Sustainable Development.
